dedupe_keys.name: mapping of product data of electrical products with designer and builder needs

description: Mapping of product data of electrical products with designer and builder needs is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Sähköteknisen Kaupan Liitto ry / STK-Tietopalvelut Oy. The most important product information for electrical products needed by designers, contractors and developers has been identified and defined on the basis of the standards used in the industry. Coverage: Sähköteknisen Kaupan Liitto ry / STK-Tietopalvelut Oy. The publisher named on the listing is Sähköteknisen Kaupan Liitto ry / STK-Tietopalvelut Oy. Its keywords include modelling, Tuotetieto, mallintaminen, Product data standard 2017, Tuotetietostandardi 2017, Product data. The listing shows 3 download or service links in PPTX, PDF, CSV, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
